# VERTEX

> Contract and project intelligence for UAE infrastructure and services contracts. Owners and reviewers upload a submission (invoice, timesheet, technical document, progress update) and receive a compliance score, a traffic light verdict, and structured findings with clause references and evidence quotes.

VERTEX is a Vite + React + TypeScript single page app backed by Supabase (Postgres, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions). It is bilingual (English and Arabic) with full right to left support, mobile first, and installable as a Progressive Web App on Android and iOS.

## Core capabilities

- Email and password authentication with Supabase Auth, roles: admin, reviewer, viewer, api_user.
- Ten row-level-secured tables that model users, projects, submissions, ai_findings, comments, kpi_tracking, mobilization_tracking, obligations, insurance_tracking, audit_log.
- Dashboard with five traffic light stat cards, a six month compliance trend line chart, submissions by status donut, recent activity feed, and alerts panel.
- Upload flow with a four step wizard that validates MIME and 25 MB size, stores files in a private Supabase Storage bucket, and inserts a submission row.
- AI analysis service abstracted over mock, Anthropic, OpenAI, and a Supabase Edge Function. Keys stay in Supabase secrets; the browser never sees them.
- Submission review page with tabs for findings, file preview, comments with mark-resolved, and audit history. Admin and reviewer approve with a confirm dialog and optional reason.
- Bilingual EN and AR translations for every screen. Layout uses CSS logical properties so it flips correctly in Arabic.

## Public URLs

- Landing: /
- Login: /login
- Dashboard (auth): /dashboard
- Upload (auth): /upload
- Submission (auth): /submissions/{id}
- Project (auth): /projects/{id}
- Manifest: /manifest.webmanifest
- Sitemap: /sitemap.xml
- Icon: /icon.svg

## Not intended for

- Drafting contracts or legal advice.
- Fully automated approval. Human sign off is required for every decision.
- Storing personally identifying information beyond what is needed to review a submission.
